text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: Novus Health renewal meeting next Thurs. CSM asked for a slim evidence + TCQ bundle for their SREs so they can validate uptime/latency claims quickly. Can we ship before Wednesday EOD? CS-4871

Devon Kaur: I will extract rolling 90d metrics (uptime + p99) and per-route latency splits (embed vs generate). Need tenant id and whether to include node-level breakdowns.

Maya Chen: Tenant 98765. Yes please include node_id and token distribution — they pushed a lot of embeddings earlier this quarter.

Priya Desai: Onboarding note: they toggled prefix caching in week 2 and applied a custom cache TTL. I can export the config diff and a short validation snippet for their infra team.

Sam Ortiz: Reminder: Novus is flagged medium renewal risk (price sensitivity). The pack should contain a plain-English credit calc and a one-line executive note about credit eligibility.

Alex Liu: I'll draft the credit calc + short FAQ. Proposed example wording:

SLO: 99.9% monthly uptime
Observed: 99.6%
Downtime = (1 - Observed) * hours_in_month
Credit = pro-rated % of monthly fee up to cap, subject to exclusions

I'll make it procurement-friendly.

sla-bot: System note — Rolling 90d for tenant 98765: uptime 99.93%. Rolling p99 latency (generate route): 185ms. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/account/98765

Devon Kaur: Export posted: https://storage.redwood.ai/exports/CS-4871/novus_90d_metrics.csv (expires in 7d). CSV columns: ts,route,latency_ms,tokens_in,tokens_out,node_id,status

Maya Chen: For the TCQ (technical checklist), include: required dashboard links and exact view ids; kubectl/logstash queries to reproduce graphs; steps to validate KV/prefix cache behavior; what model variant + quant profile we served.

Priya Desai: Kubectl snippet to show recent latency for tenant 98765:

kubectl logs -l app=runtime -c inference --since=72h | grep \"tenant=98765\" | jq '.latency_ms, .route'

I'll attach the onboarding config diff.

Devon Kaur: Note: p99 spikes align with requests >4k tokens on generate route. Should we call out token distribution so they know root cause? Also, do we annotate maintenance exclusions in the evidence pack?

Maya Chen: Yes on both. Add a short blurb: \"Tail latency primarily driven by long-sequence generates; embedding route stays sub-200ms p99.\" Include maintenance windows (pre-agreed) as exclusions.

Sam Ortiz: Add an FAQ Q: \"Will we get credits automatically?\" Answer: credit application requires a validated incident calculation and is applied to the next invoice after dispute resolution (typical 1-2 billing cycles). Keep it 2 sentences.

Alex Liu: Draft FAQ bullets in plain language done. Also added sample table for credit computation they can paste.

Maya Chen: Action list: 1) Devon: metrics export (done) ✓ 2) Priya: onboarding config + runbook snippet (in progress) 3) Alex: credit calc + FAQ (due Wed EOD) 4) Maya: assemble PDF evidence pack + upload to ticket CS-4871 (due Thu)

Devon Kaur: Quick decision: include quantization details for the embed model? It changes latency numbers.

Priya Desai: They run quantized small-embed-v2 on Dedicated. I'll include the exact quant profile name and the baseline throughput numbers we measured.

Maya Chen: I'll stitch everything into a single PDF and attach to the ticket once QC'd. Sam — can you provide the 1-line exec summary for the top of the pack?

Sam Ortiz: Sent exec line in thread DM to Maya. One-liner will highlight stable uptime and credit eligibility language.

sla-bot: Ticket CS-4871 updated — evidence_pack_draft.pdf uploaded by maya.chen at 1735561800. Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/cs/CS-4871/evidence_pack_draft.pdf

Maya Chen: Uploaded draft. Please review quickly; I'll finalize and send to Novus once all comments are in.

Devon Kaur: Reviewing CSV now, will flag anything surprising.

Priya Desai: Pushed config diff and runbook snippet to the ticket. Added validation steps for KV cache hits.

Alex Liu: Added plain-English paragraph about credits + sample calc table to the draft.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — will finalize Thu morning and send. Mark thread resolved after Novus confirms receipt.
